part_a_user_inputs.topic: Từ vựng chủ đề gia đình (Family Vocabulary)
part_a_user_inputs.working_title: Family Members & Relatives: Essential Vocabulary & Interactive Practice (A1–A2)
user_constraints: Must include dedicated interactive practice exercises (bài tập luyện tập)
Strictly calibrated for A1-A2 comprehension level

part_b_ai_pedagogical_proposal.curricular_fit_analysis: For A1-A2 learners, family vocabulary is a cornerstone communicative topic. A1 requires mastering immediate/nuclear family members (parents, siblings, children). A2 extends to 3-generation kinship (grandparents, grandchildren) and relational relatives (uncles, aunts, cousins, nephews, nieces). Combining vocabulary acquisition with sentence frames ('This is my...', 'He is her...') and 2 structured micro-practice games establishes immediate speaking and listening competence.
part_b_ai_pedagogical_proposal.core_cognitive_obstacle: Vietnamese L1 interference presents two severe friction points: (1) Asymmetry of kinship systems: Vietnamese distinguishes relatives by age and maternal/paternal lineage ('bác, chú, cô, dì, cậu, thím, mợ'), whereas English collapses these into broad gendered categories ('uncle', 'aunt') or gender-neutral ('cousin'). (2) Pronunciation and phonological stumbling blocks: Voiced dental fricative /ð/ in 'father, mother, brother', final /s/ in 'parents', and distinction between /s/ and /z/ in 'niece' vs 'nephew/cousin'.

recommended_didactic_strategy.pedagogical_rationale: A 3-generation Visual Family Tree acts as an invariant cognitive anchor. Learners do not memorize isolated word lists; they observe spatial relationships on the whiteboard (Generation 1: Grandparents -> Generation 2: Parents, Uncle/Aunt -> Generation 3: Self, Sibling, Cousin). The lesson uses Concrete-Representational-Abstract (CRA) staging, transitioning from character avatars into structural branches, then into relational linguistic formulas, culminating in interactive game challenges.

in_scope: Generation 2: father, mother, parents, uncle, aunt
Generation 3: brother, sister, siblings, son, daughter, children, cousin, nephew, niece
Collective/Plural terms: parents, grandparents, children, siblings, relatives
Pronunciation spotlights on /ð/ sound (father, mother, brother) and final consonants
Interactive Practice 1: 'Who is this?' (Visual Identification Challenge)
Interactive Practice 2: 'Family Tree Riddle' (Relational Deduction Challenge)
out_of_scope_exclusions: Multi-tier in-laws (father-in-law, sister-in-law) — deferred to B1 to prevent cognitive overload
Blended/step-family terms (step-father, half-brother) — excluded for clarity
Distant relatives (great-grandparents, second cousin once removed) — strictly forbidden

recommended_macro_structure: Module 1: Hook & The Family Tree Anchor (~45s) — Introduction to Liam's family
Module 2: The Nuclear Family (~65s) — Parents, siblings, children, and collective terms
Module 3: The Grandparents & Three Generations (~50s) — Grandparents, grandchildren
Module 4: Extended Relatives & The L1 Trap (~75s) — Uncle, aunt, cousin, nephew, niece (debunking Vietnamese over-complication)
Module 5: Pronunciation Lab (~35s) — The secret of the /ð/ sound in father/mother/brother
Module 6: Interactive Practice Challenge 1 (~55s) — Flash Quiz: Name the relative before the 3-second hand countdown
Module 7: Interactive Practice Challenge 2 (~50s) — The Family Detective Riddle
Module 8: Summary Anchor Rule (~25s) — Visual recap of the completed tree

visual_cognitive_accelerators.visual_metaphor: Top-to-bottom branch diagram with distinct horizontal generation tiers (Gen 1, Gen 2, Gen 3)
visual_cognitive_accelerators.ink_color_strategy: Black outlines for avatars; Cobalt Blue #2563EB for male titles; Teal #0D9488 for female titles; Warm Orange #EA580C for connector arrows and collective bracket labels

visual_cognitive_accelerators.visual_metaphor: Hand drawing a wide bracket uniting Father + Mother labeled 'PARENTS', and Brother + Sister labeled 'SIBLINGS'
visual_cognitive_accelerators.ink_color_strategy: Orange bracket #EA580C with crisp black typography

visual_cognitive_accelerators.visual_metaphor: Marker draws a ticking clock / '3... 2... 1...' countdown with a prominent question mark, followed by hand revealing the correct answer badge
visual_cognitive_accelerators.ink_color_strategy: Orange alert circle with vibrant checkmark reveal

scope_duration_veto_analysis.verdict: Optimal pedagogical density. Allows adequate hand-drawing time (2-3s per icon), unhurried pronunciation modeling, and full 3-second thinking pauses for learners during exercises.

decisions_log.decision: Fixed target duration at 400s (~6m40s), perfectly within user's 5-10m range.
Included 2 distinct interactive practice modules (Flash Identification + Relational Riddle) to satisfy practice mandate.
Excluded complex in-laws to keep cognitive focus sharp for A1-A2.

risks_and_mitigations.risk: Learners getting confused by Vietnamese paternal vs maternal uncle/aunt distinctions.
risks_and_mitigations.mitigation: Scene specifically illustrates that English simplifies all brothers of parents into 'Uncle' and all sisters into 'Aunt', shown with side-by-side connector arrows.
